environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in a private VPC subnet. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the instance. No application-layer inspection is performed. Security groups allow inbound 443 from partner CIDR ranges. The application runs as ec2-user with read access to /etc/passwd and instance metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) is accessible via IMDSv1.

config.network: VPC private subnet, SG allows 443 from 10.0.0.0/8
